stem.en: Ravi suddenly notices that he is growing taller rapidly, his shoulders are broadening, and his voice cracks. What stage of life is he entering?

text.en: Infancy, the time just after birth

feedback.en: Infancy is the first stage of life, long before these changes.

text.en: Adolescence, with the changes of puberty

feedback.en: Correct. The hormone from the testes causes these changes in boys.

text.en: Adulthood, as he has now finished all his growing

feedback.en: He is still changing, and emotional maturity takes longer.

text.en: Old age, because his body has started to change

feedback.en: These are changes of growing up, not of growing old.

explanation.en: A growth spurt, broader shoulders and a changing voice are physical changes of puberty, which happen in adolescence. In boys they are caused by a hormone made in the testes.

hints.en: Which stage comes between childhood and adulthood?
